minor_findings.summary: A few Unicode presentation forms were normalized.
minor_findings.evidence: The candidate uses an en dash where the original title uses an em dash and ASCII 6 where the original yield and baked-output label use full-width ６; the words, quantities, and multilingual meaning remain unchanged.

rationale: All ingredients, multilingual labels, setup requirements, operation dependencies, timing, completion criteria, and the final crème brûlée are semantically complete. The only differences are immaterial Unicode punctuation and numeral-width normalization.
